summary: Iteration 39 — Validated God-Mode Market CRUD + Character Origins CRUD end-to-end. 17/17 backend pytest assertions passed and full Playwright UI walk-through (Markets create+delete, Origins new/edit-prefill/delete, character-create screen listing 5 DB origins) all green. Cleanup verified — no test assets/origins remain in DB.
critical_code_review_comments: routes/admin.py POST /admin/market correctly rejects duplicate symbol (400) and invalid kind (400); DELETE returns 404 for unknown id.
market_engine reads db.market_assets dynamically so new admin-created assets are advanced on next refresh — verified refresh 'advanced' count includes the newly created asset.
routes/admin.py DELETE /admin/backgrounds has count-guard (>=1 must remain) at line 649 — logic verified by inspection (not triggered during tests as required).

_norm_background clamps stats to [0,100] and skill levels to [0,20]; player character-create correctly applies bg cash/bank/debt at player root + skill bonus additive to base level 1 (finance 1+5=6, sales 1+2=3 verified).
Player-token admin routes correctly return 403 for both /admin/market and /admin/backgrounds.
GET /backgrounds is public (no auth) and only returns active=true origins — matches character-create screen behavior.
Admin.jsx MarketsPanel data-testids conform to spec (market-create, market-new-symbol/name/kind/price/create, market-delete-<id>).

CharacterOriginsPanel data-testids conform to spec (origin-card-<id>, origin-edit-<id>, origin-delete-<id>, origin-new, origin-editor, origin-label/desc/cash/bank/debt, origin-stat-<key>, origin-skill-<skill>, origin-additem, origin-save, origin-cancel). Edit pre-fills correctly.

Nit: Admin.jsx TabBtn generates data-testid=`admin-tab-<label>` only for the small Dashboard/Live-Feed toggle. The 6 domain group tabs (Overview / Economy / Gameplay Tuning / Player Management / City Infrastructure / Underworld & Finance) DO NOT expose data-testid attributes — testing had to click them by accessible role/name. Consider adding data-testid=`admin-domain-<key>` for stable QA.
seed_data_creation: All test data cleaned up. Backend test created + deleted 1 stock (ZZ****) and 1 crypto (QQ****) via admin routes, and created + updated + deleted the QA Origin (label 'QA Origin'). Character-create test registered a throwaway user qa_origin_<hex>@test.com (not deleted — consistent with prior iterations' throwaway users). Frontend test created + deleted 1 stock (QATxxx) and 1 origin (qauiorigin), and registered throwaway user qauser_<hex>@test.com. No lingering test assets/origins remain in DB.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 39 covers Market CRUD (POST/DELETE /api/admin/market with engine auto-pickup+stop, duplicate 400, invalid kind 400) and Character Origins CRUD (GET/POST/PUT/DELETE /api/admin/backgrounds, count guard, public /api/backgrounds active-only, character/create applying bg cash/bank/debt/stats/skills additive). Domain group tabs on Admin have NO data-testid — use get_by_role('button', name='Underworld & Finance') / 'Player Management'. Subtab labels use TabBtn (data-testid admin-tab-<lowercase-label>). Character-create route is /create-character (not /character/create). Register requires {email, password, name}. game/state returns {player, ...} with cash/bank/debt/health/energy/stress at player root (not under .stats). /market/stocks and /backgrounds return raw arrays (not wrapped).
